name: Pac-12 Cross Country Championships
where: Boise, ID · host Boise State · Warm Springs Golf Course
headline: Pac-12 Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Washington State's Solomon Kipchoge won the men's 8K in 22:46.8 and Nelly Jemeli took the women's 6K in 19:57.0, but the team titles went separate ways. Gonzaga won the men's team race with 39 points ahead of Utah State (56) and Washington State (59), while Washington State won the women's title with 50 points to Boise State's 62.
